parsed.answer: Immediately after the August 8 meeting, the still-approved delivery mode for Ivo's Cobalt project was BATCH-1-741. Ivo had originally chosen BATCH-1-741 for batch delivery when Cobalt started on August 1. On August 8, the team tested REPLAY-1-632 after BATCH-1-741 lost updates, but no change of delivery mode was approved at that meeting—so the test did not replace the approved mode.

citations.quote: 2026-08-01. Ivo started project Cobalt. They chose BATCH-1-741 for batch delivery.

2026-08-08. Ivo reported that BATCH-1-741 lost updates during GATE-1-519 outages. The team tested REPLAY-1-632, which restored the missing updates. No change of delivery mode was approved at this meeting.
